title: The Flor Contemplacion Story
description: The tragic tale of the Filipino maid hanged for the murder in Singapore in 1995 not only called the attention to the plight of overseas workers everywhere in the world but also resulted in one of the most acclaimed movies in Philippine motion picture history. Nora Aunor as Flor gives a stirring performance as the poverty-stricken woman who enslaved herself to foreign masters to give her family a better life. In return she lost her husband to another woman and alienated the affections of her children. She also lost her life.
